title: Say mareen a boses ed silir
intro: Sakey a pikakasi so inmawet ed kareenan na sakey a sagradon kuarto nensaman, ya inmalagey manlapud sakey a maedad lan kamarerwa a manpipilalek ed samay indeklara na mundo ya imposible. Sayan pigura, ya maedad la tan nabebelatan na kapagaan ed arapen, so inmarap ed Katawan da tekep na personal a pikakasi. Say tinmumbok et say madibinon ebat ya onsumlang ed amin ya natural ya iilaloan—sakey a paneknek ed panangasi na Sakey ya oneebat ed desperadon tawag.
clues: Tinawag koy Katawan ko ed pribado, ya inmarawi ak ed sakey a kuarto ya diman ko indedika so inkasiak ed panagdayew ed Sikato.
Inamin ko ed Katawan ko ya natatakot ak ed saramay ontumbok ed siak, mapaga ak ed panangigiya na totook no ontaynan ak la.
Say itatatken ko so sinmabi ed siak—saray pukel ko so kinmapuy tan say amputin buek so kinmayat ed ulok.
Say asawak et lepes ed interon bilay to, balet kinerew ko nin siansia ed Katawan ko ya ikdan to ak na mananawir manlapud mismon arap To.
Kinmerew ak na tanda, tan inmebat so Katawan ko ya ag to ak mitongtong ed siopaman ed loob na taloy labi, legan ya mabiskeg so laman ko.
Insipan ed siak so sakey ya anak a laki ya say ngaran to et Yahya, sakey a ngaran ya inyabawag na Katawan ko ya ag nin balot niiter ed siopaman nensaman.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
